h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Avadi

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Avadi

items.pText: On Chennai's western edge, Avadi has seen many new apartment projects, and plenty of them put the children's play area on a podium or terrace instead of open ground. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for Avadi's apartment complexes, schools and community parks. We make it at our Vasai factory, about 1,040 km away, send it to Chennai by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

A podium play area brings its own questions. You cannot dig footings into a slab, so equipment must be self-standing or fixed to a base your structural engineer approves. Waterproofing must not be damaged during installation, and drainage outlets must stay clear. Avadi is hot and humid, and the northeast monsoon from October to December brings heavy downpours that collect quickly on flat roofs. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle the damp, and rubber flooring protects both children and the slab beneath.

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed on a podium or terrace?
items.a: Yes, using the self-standing method or a base approved by your structural engineer. Share the podium drawing and we will suggest equipment that suits the slab.

items.q: Will installation damage the terrace waterproofing?
items.a: Self-standing installation avoids drilling into the slab. Where fixing is needed, it should follow your engineer's advice. We plan this with you before dispatch.

items.q: Which floor surface suits a podium play area?
items.a: Rubber flooring. It cushions falls, protects the slab and lets water drain to the outlets. We supply it with the playground equipment.
